components.derived_one_use_host_total: native cold_one_use_host_total_us is one_time_setup_host_us + median_host_us; a derived setup-plus-batch sum, not full cold request latency
components.group_metadata: group_metadata_host_us records one-time stable assignment preparation measured by prep_us; it is inside one_time_setup_host_us and outside CUDA-event samples

timing_scope.device_event: gather + both up/gate GEMMs for every nonempty expert + FP32 SiLU/product + scatter; stable assignment grouping is one-time host preparation outside the CUDA-event scope
timing_scope.setup_host: input+oracle file read/parse, stable assignment grouping, allocations, H2D and sync
timing_scope.synchronized_host: per-invocation submit through synchronized completion; stable assignment grouping is prepared once before sampled invocations

components.derived_prep_plus_batch_device_total: native cold_device_event_total_us is predecode_event_us median plus reuse-batch event median for predecode-w4, or reuse-batch event median for direct-w4; setup and input transfer are excluded
components.derived_setup_prep_plus_batch_host_total: native cold_host_wall_total_us is one_time_setup_host_us plus predecode_host_us median plus reuse-batch host median; this derived subtotal is not full cold invocation latency
components.paired_M_control: M=1 and M=16 within each K/N family share byte-identical packed codes/scales; activations are independent, not prefix-matched
components.predecode: predecode-w4 reports separate nine-sample medians in predecode_event_us and predecode_host_us for packed-nibble/scale decode to FP16; direct-w4 reports zero preparation
components.reuse_compute: dense cuBLAS after decode for predecode-w4; direct fused decode+SIMT dot for direct-w4
components.reuse_condition: host-controlled resident-data reuse; unchanged activation/codes/scales within each case; no L2/HBM residency claim

timing_scope.device_event: first decode preparation and repeated compute are sampled separately as listed in components
timing_scope.setup_host: input+oracle file read/parse, allocations, H2D and sync
timing_scope.synchronized_host: synchronized wall time for each listed operation scope
